title: 1262. Greatest Sum Divisible by Three

examples.explanation: Pick numbers 3, 6, 1 and 8 their sum is 18 (maximum sum divisible by 3).
Since 4 is not divisible by 3, do not pick any number.
Pick numbers 1, 3, 4 and 4 their sum is 12 (maximum sum divisible by 3).
